scope: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence enrichment for the five remaining 78-character mechanics footprints identified by the live skills-index census.

records.name: Rolling Hercule Punch
records.mechanics: 100-Ki Strike Super that lets the user roll forward before punching; repeated input extends the rolling movement. The punch can daze the opponent for about a second, enabling follow-up attacks, and the move has super armor. Exact frames and source-dependent damage remain unresolved.
records.evidence_boundary: Source-reported damage and timing are not treated as patch-independent; no hidden gate, reward probability, frame data, or universal balance value inferred.

records.name: Saturday Crash
records.mechanics: 100-Ki tracking Ki Blast Super that paralyzes the target on hit. Current skill documentation describes roughly one second of paralysis and very quick recovery, while historical community reporting documents a faster projectile after an update; exact current timing and damage remain unresolved.
records.evidence_boundary: Historical patch discussion is preserved as version context; no exact frame timing, hidden gate, reward probability, or patch-independent damage value inferred.

records.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack
records.mechanics: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super that creates one ghost which automatically rushes the opponent when they enter range or after about 4 seconds; the hit stuns the target. Source-reported damage is about 10%; exact timing remains version-sensitive.
records.evidence_boundary: The 4-second trigger and damage are source-reported mechanics, not independently benchmarked; no hidden gate, probability, or frame data inferred.

records.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack (Ultimate)
records.mechanics: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate that creates five ghosts which launch sequentially after about 5 seconds. The first and last ghosts are documented at about 10% damage each, with intermediate hits reported higher; the attack produces a five-hit knockback sequence.
records.evidence_boundary: Damage values are source-reported and version-sensitive; no exact frame data, reward probability, hidden gate, or universal damage claim inferred.

records.name: Supernova Cooler
records.mechanics: 500-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate that charges a large projectile and throws it at the target. Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation records an 18-hit sequence and source-reported total damage around 45%; it starts faster than Frieza's Supernova but trades some damage for the faster startup.
records.evidence_boundary: Damage and startup comparisons are source-reported; no exact frame data, hidden gate, reward probability, or patch-independent damage claim inferred.
